principle: Few source materials, many musical transformations.
preferred: raw one-shots and material recordings over polished loops

pulse.role: physical or mental time axis: soft kicks, low thuds, sub impulses

skin.role: one drum family per song: frame drum, bongo, hand drum, open/muted articulations

seed.role: small high-frequency motion: shaker, seed rattle, wood click, clave

tremor.role: rough tonal source material: bowed metal, friction, resonant scrape, tonal noise

memory.role: one restrained melodic color: breath-like winds, plucked strings, reed tones

ground.role: foundation: drones, room tones, air, low resonance

vcsl.mode: seed library, selected paths only, provenance pinned to commit hash

wikimedia.mode: supplementary one-shots, extmetadata license verification, CC0 auto-accept only

openverse.mode: discovery only; canonical provider verification required before download; Freesound results become manual candidates, never automatic downloads
